land_acres.label: Land area, acres (hypothetical airport-area industrial site)
land_acres.assumption: A round hypothetical site of about three acres: room for a single-story refrigerated building with truck docks on two sides, trailer staging and a reefer truck yard. A listing acreage would be a property attribute, so the study sizes the site from the building. The site plan fixes the real figure.

land_per_acre.label: Land cost per acre
land_per_acre.assumption: The research holds no Anchorage industrial land sale or listing it can print, and broker land evidence is NOT FOUND. The study carries a round $300,000 an acre as a planning figure, to be replaced by an appraisal and an executed land contract.

bldg_sf.label: Refrigerated building, gross square feet
bldg_sf.assumption: A round size for a single-story building with coolers, freezers, a dock and a small office. The size is a design assumption, not a market observation; the research holds no Anchorage cold storage building size.

bldg_psf.label: Building hard cost per square foot, insulated shell, floors and docks
bldg_psf.assumption: No Anchorage construction cost index was found; the research lists it as NOT FOUND. The study carries a round figure for an insulated panel shell with a heated slab and dock doors, with the refrigeration plant priced separately. A contractor bid replaces it.

refrig_equip.label: Refrigeration plant, evaporators, controls and pallet racking
refrig_equip.assumption: Allowance for a refrigeration plant sized to freezers and coolers, controls and racking for the pallet positions below. No vendor quote was found.

sitework.label: Site work, paving, utility taps, lighting and fencing
sitework.assumption: Allowance for a three-acre industrial site, including frost-protected paving for truck turning. Utility territory and tap fees were not confirmed.

contingency_pct.label: Hard-cost contingency
contingency_pct.assumption: Seven percent of building, refrigeration and site work, a round allowance for a priced but unbid special purpose building in a high-cost state.

soft.label: Design, engineering, survey, Phase I, permits, food-safety design review and legal
soft.assumption: Allowance. The research found no Anchorage fee schedule for commercial permits; it found only that commercial zoning review now runs 20 business days [^11].

trucks.label: Two refrigerated delivery trucks
trucks.assumption: Allowance for two new reefer straight trucks for the distribution line. A dealer quote replaces it.

preopen.label: Pre-opening: hiring, training, commissioning, food-safety audits and customer onboarding
preopen.assumption: Allowance. Staff are trained and the plant is commissioned before the first pallet.

working_capital.label: Working capital and ramp reserve
working_capital.assumption: Roughly four months of Year 2 operating cost to carry payroll and power while customers move in. The research holds no days-receivable figure.

positions.label: Pallet positions
positions.assumption: A round capacity for about 20,000 square feet of high-bay racked cooler and freezer space. A rack layout fixes the real count; the research holds no Anchorage cold storage capacity.

occupancy.label: Share of pallet positions occupied, each year
occupancy.assumption: A new operator fills positions as customers sign. The ramp is a planning assumption: the research holds no Anchorage cold storage vacancy, and the air cargo, seafood and grocery volumes that would fill the building are NOT FOUND in a form that reaches it. Signed storage agreements replace it.

storage_rate.label: Storage charge per occupied pallet position per month
storage_rate.assumption: No published Anchorage cold storage rate was found. The study carries a round planning rate and treats it as the most important price assumption; signed customer agreements replace it.

turns.label: Pallets handled in and out per occupied position per year
turns.assumption: A round planning figure for a mix of grocery and seafood accounts. No Anchorage throughput data was found.

handling_rate.label: Handling charge per pallet received and shipped
handling_rate.assumption: A round planning rate for in and out handling. No Anchorage handling tariff was found.

stops.label: Refrigerated delivery stops per year
stops.assumption: A round ramp for two trucks serving grocery and food service accounts in the Anchorage bowl. The register holds a count of grocery establishments in the county, not any customer commitment.

rev_per_stop.label: Delivery revenue per stop
rev_per_stop.assumption: A round planning figure for a delivery charge per stop. No Anchorage refrigerated delivery tariff was found.

wh_fte.label: Warehouse full-time equivalents
wh_fte.assumption: Receiving, put-away, picking and shipping staff at the stabilized volume. A staffing plan replaces it.

wh_wage.label: Warehouse annual wage before payroll costs
wh_wage.assumption: About $29 an hour for a full year. The Anchorage mean hourly wage for all occupations was $36.14 in May 2025 [^5]; the study sets cold-chain warehouse labor at a discount to that all-occupation mean. A local wage survey replaces it.

driver_wage.label: Driver annual wage before payroll costs
driver_wage.assumption: A round figure set above warehouse labor for commercial drivers, against the all-occupation mean of $36.14 an hour [^5]. The Anchorage transportation and material moving group held 17,980 jobs in May 2025 [^5], so drivers and warehouse hands draw on a large local group.

mgmt_payroll.label: General manager, operations supervisor, sales and office payroll, before payroll costs
mgmt_payroll.assumption: One allowance for four salaried roles. A market salary is charged even where the owner fills a role.

burden.label: Payroll taxes, workers compensation and benefits
burden.assumption: A round employer cost on wages; no Alaska figure was in the research.

inflation.label: Annual growth in wages and operating costs
inflation.assumption: A round 3% a year. Anchorage prices rose 3.3% over twelve months to August 2026 [^6], which the study treats as the upper end for the planning period. Rates charged to customers are held flat.

kwh_psf.label: Electricity use, kilowatt hours per square foot per year
kwh_psf.assumption: A planning figure for a refrigerated building with freezers. No Anchorage use data was found; a refrigeration engineer replaces it.

kwh_rate.label: Electricity price per kilowatt hour
kwh_rate.assumption: No Anchorage commercial electric tariff was found, and the utility serving the site is a condition to confirm. A utility rate letter replaces it.

vehicle.label: Fuel, truck maintenance, licences and truck insurance
vehicle.assumption: One allowance for two delivery trucks.

insurance.label: Property, liability and spoilage insurance
insurance.assumption: Allowance for a refrigerated building with stored product. A broker quote replaces it; earthquake cover is a separate lender condition.

repairs.label: Refrigeration service contract, repairs and janitorial
repairs.assumption: One allowance for plant service and building repairs.

supplies_pct.label: Pallets, wrap, labels and packaging, share of revenue

admin.label: Warehouse software, accounting, phones, licences and food-safety audits

tax_rate.label: Property tax, share of land, building and refrigeration cost
tax_rate.assumption: A planning level. The research holds no Anchorage commercial mill rate or assessment ratio, so the levy cannot be computed and is a lender condition.

reserve_pct.label: Replacement reserve, share of refrigeration and truck cost per year
reserve_pct.assumption: Funds compressor, evaporator and truck replacement over a long cycle.

tpl_rate.label: Bank first-lien rate
tpl_rate.assumption: Prime of 7.00% in the October 9, 2026 H.15 release [^25] plus half a point for a start-up special purpose building. No published Anchorage bank terms were found; the bank sets the rate at pricing.

tpl_amort_years.label: Bank first-lien amortization
tpl_amort_years.assumption: 25 years, matching the debenture. A bank may require a shorter term, which would raise debt service.

debenture_rate.label: 504 debenture effective rate, 25-year
debenture_rate.assumption: A round planning rate. The research holds no 2026 debenture pricing, and the rate is fixed when the debenture is sold. A CDC rate quote replaces it.

debenture_years.label: Debenture term
debenture_years.assumption: The 25-year debenture, available because land, building and site work are the majority of project cost.

uses.label: Land, about 3 acres near the airport
uses.basis: acres x assumed price per acre

uses.label: Refrigerated building, 20,000 sq ft
uses.basis: sq ft x assumed hard cost

uses.label: Site work, paving and utility taps
Design, survey, Phase I, permits and legal
Working capital and ramp reserve
uses.basis: about four months of Year 2 operating cost

revenue.label: Pallet storage charges
revenue.basis: positions x occupancy x monthly rate

revenue.label: Handling charges
revenue.basis: occupied positions x turns x rate

opex.label: Management and office payroll with costs
Electricity
opex.basis: sq ft x kWh x price

opex.label: Property tax
opex.expr: (land_acres * land_per_acre + bldg_sf * bldg_psf + refrig_equip + sitework) * tax_rate

proposed.note: the sponsor applies the 15% tier for a special purpose property and overlooks that the business is also new
